name: [UNOFFICIAL] TaCZ Refabricated (26.3 R1)
description: An unofficial Fabric port of Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero, based on upstream 1.1.8-hotfix. R1 for Minecraft 26.3 is the first build targeting the 26.3 ('Wilderness Bound') drop: it re-pins the toolchain to Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5, Fabric API 0.160.6+26.3, Forge Config API Port 26.3.0 and Cloth Config 26.3.158, and carries forward all R3-hotfix2 feature work (built-in TacZ Mesh Loader with first-person GPU static baking, in-scope clipping of arms/reticle/sight text under shaders, scope text / inspect-animation / PIP fixes, the Mac/Iris world-transparency fix, zRot=±0.1 rad neutralisation for first-person arms, replaceable-ammunition and named gameplay-hook surfaces, Carry On 2.11 workbench compatibility, built-in JEI/REI Ammo Query and post-sync recipe-viewer refreshes). Optional integrations with JEI (31.0.0.5 beta) and Mod Menu (21.0.1-beta.1) are built against their current 26.3 beta builds; Zoomify, REI and Shoulder Surfing are held at their 26.2 coordinates until those mods publish 26.3 builds. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the TACZ Dev Team. The version keeps 1.1.8 as its SemVer core and uses '+fabric.26.3.R1' build metadata so existing gun-pack version requirements continue to work.
contributors: TACZ Dev Team (upstream Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero)
